records.title: Geographic Information Systems
records.header: B GIS 342 Geographic Information Systems (5) SSc
records.text: B GIS 342 Geographic Information Systems (5) SSc Examines the concepts and methods of geographic information systems (GIS) and related elements of spatial analysis and representation. Through projects and lab exercises, student gain basic proficiency in the use of GIS and an interdisciplinary understanding of the applications of GIS.

records.title: Geographic Visualization
records.header: B GIS 343 Geographic Visualization (5) SSc, RSN
records.text: B GIS 343 Geographic Visualization (5) SSc, RSN Focuses on different geovisualization techniques to represent physical, social, and cultural phenomena associated with spatial data and designing maps. Addresses GIS programs and explores how geovisualization can be applied to various research and policy areas. Course overlaps with: GEOG 360 and T GIS 460.

records.title: Intermediate Geographic Analysis and Applications
records.header: B GIS 344 Intermediate Geographic Analysis and Applications (5) NSc, RSN
records.text: B GIS 344 Intermediate Geographic Analysis and Applications (5) NSc, RSN Provides intermediate level training in Geographic Information Systems (GIS) for the analysis of environmental and spatial data. Emphasizes on the applications of raster and vector modeling to map and analyze geo-spatial phenomena, and proposes solutions to environmental problems. Course overlaps with: ESS 329 and T GIS 311. Prerequisite: B GIS 342 or B GIS 343.

records.title: Advanced Geographic Information Systems Analysis and Applications
records.header: B GIS 442 Advanced Geographic Information Systems Analysis and Applications (5, max. 15) SSc
records.text: B GIS 442 Advanced Geographic Information Systems Analysis and Applications (5, max. 15) SSc Provides advanced training in Geographic Information Systems and other geospatial applications for display and analysis of environmental and socio-economic data. Prerequisite: B GIS 342 or B GIS 343.
